name: Kyrgyzstan
about: Summer (Jun–Sep) is the only real window for high-altitude trekking and yurt stays at Song-Köl and Issyk-Köl; winter is bitterly cold across the mountains.
overview: Nicknamed the 'Switzerland of Central Asia' — the Tian Shan mountains, alpine lakes reached on horseback, and a living nomadic yurt culture, at a fraction of the cost of better-known trekking destinations.
costOverview: One of the cheapest genuine adventure-travel destinations anywhere — yurt stays, horseback treks, and everyday food all cost a fraction of neighboring China or Kazakhstan.
